status: evidence-guided candidate; numerical proxies are inferred, not measured medieval values

china.interpretation: Cultivated lowland wet-rice cells within the previous extensive-upland assignment receive the existing managed-system coefficients. Preserve old natural base and uplands; no new cropland or irrigation service.

prairie.interpretation: Replace automatic 10–15% open-land agriculture with a small accessible fraction increasing near rivers; preserve reconstructed cultivated area and physical maximum. Fractions are explicit uncertain analogues, not observations.

andes.interpretation: Prefer historically available potatoes over maize in the documented altitude band if adjusted potato scenarios are viable; preserve old baseline support and land/water budgets. Terraces remain embodied in reconstructed cultivation, with no invented additional hectares.

selection: Central values frozen before candidate comparisons; sensitivity ranges expose uncertainty and are not used to fit population.

coldfields.interpretation: Inferred cold-adapted field-system analogue only where HYDE records cultivation and standard potato upper yield is zero on relatively level puna. Four t fresh per harvested hectare and alternate-year cropping are conservative transfer assumptions, not historical observations. No additional hectares or water, no universal terrace/raised-field gain.

improvement_reference.interpretation: Conditional improvement productivity in non-crop Plains/Rockies systems, using the same maize/rotation reference as adjacent agricultural systems. Not a claim of historical cultivation. Reference normalization only: does not change actual food, land, irrigation service or total support. Irrigated yield is conditional per improved hectare, not permission to irrigate additional land. Missing scenario data remain excluded.
